intro.h2: A Malden remodeler that builds its own cabinets
paragraphs: Halco Kitchen & Bath handles kitchen remodeling in Malden, MA and across the Boston area north to southern New Hampshire. The team designs the space, supplies the cabinetry and manages construction, so the plan, the boxes and the install all come from one company.

Cabinets are where Halco stands apart. You can choose quick ship, semi custom or full custom lines, or the company's own fully custom Halco Cabinet, in overlay, inset or frameless styles at any price point. Every project carries a 5-year warranty, and cabinetry adds a limited lifetime warranty.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Malden, MA, baths, cabinetry and additions

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen renovations planned with Halco's design team, from layout and cabinetry to counters and lighting. Recent kitchens include a navy-island kitchen in Ipswich, a two-tone kitchen in Beverly, a walnut kitchen in Wakefield and a custom-color kitchen in Melrose.

image.alt: Ipswich, MA kitchen with a navy island, orange counter stools, wood ceiling beams, blue tile backsplash and white cabinets

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, guest baths and condo bathrooms with custom vanities, tile and fixtures. Portfolio work includes a primary bath in North Reading, contemporary bathrooms in a South End condo and a bath in Cambridge, each paired with Halco cabinetry.

image.alt: North Reading, MA primary bathroom with a charcoal double vanity, white quartz top, oval mirrors and light blue walls

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Quick ship, semi custom, full custom and Halco's own fully custom Halco Cabinet, in overlay, inset or frameless construction. Beyond kitchens, the team builds pantries, built-ins, bar cabinetry and mudroom benches, all with a limited lifetime warranty on cabinetry.

image.alt: Lynnfield, MA built-in pantry with navy cabinetry, a butcher-block counter, farmhouse sink and brass faucet

items.name: Additions and Mudrooms
items.blurb: Expanding the existing home, attached or detached garages, sunrooms, porches and decks, plus mudrooms, basements and attics. Halco lists 12 to 16 weeks for a typical addition, project dependent, and recent work includes an addition in Middleton.

image.alt: Middleton, MA home addition with sage siding, a dark roof, a covered front porch and attached two-car garage

items.name: New Construction
items.blurb: Design and building of new homes, typically 6 months to a year depending on the project. Halco's featured new construction in Middleton shows a two-story colonial with a full-width porch, coffered ceilings and an open kitchen and living area.

image.alt: Front view of a two-story new construction home with gray siding, white columns, a black front door and fall mums on the steps

why_choose_us.h2: Why North Shore homeowners call Halco

items.title: Cabinets at every price point
items.text: Halco designs with quick ship, semi custom, full custom and its own Halco Cabinet line, so you can match the look you want to your budget without changing contractors.

items.title: Warranties in plain numbers
items.text: Every associated project carries a 5-year warranty, and cabinetry comes with a limited lifetime warranty. Both are stated on the site, not hidden in a contract.

items.title: Timelines you can plan around
items.text: Interior remodels typically run 5 to 7 weeks, additions 12 to 16 weeks and new construction 6 months to a year, each project dependent, so you can plan around the work.

items.title: A contained, clean job site
items.text: The crew lays floor protection and plastic walls to keep dust in the work area, and you track the schedule and documents in an online project portal. Google reviewers note a clean workspace and a project that stayed on schedule.

about.text: Halco is led by co-owners Tyler Procopio, Vice President of Construction, and Tim Procopio Jr., Vice President of Operations. Ally Procopio directs operations and Kelly Procopio directs marketing. Designer Amanda Rivera works with clients on layouts and finishes, project manager Erin Roe keeps jobs on track, and carpenters Wesley Oliveria, Blad Martins and Felipe Ferares do the build. One Google reviewer described setting up a consultation with Jarod and Tyler, who came out to the house to take measurements before designing her new kitchen.

image.alt: Tyler Procopio, co-owner of Halco Kitchen & Bath in Malden, MA

process.h2: What happens from first call to final inspection

steps.title: Discovery call or home visit
steps.text: Start with a discovery phone call or an in-home consultation so the team understands your project, explains the process and answers early questions.

steps.title: Contract and scheduling
steps.text: After the contract is signed and the deposit is placed, a team member sets your anticipated start date and opens your online project portal.

steps.title: Prep and protection
steps.text: You clear the work area of furniture, decor and cabinet contents. The crew lays floor protection and builds plastic walls to keep dust contained.

steps.title: Demo, framing and inspection
steps.text: The crew completes demolition, framing and rough mechanicals, and the town inspector signs off before any walls are closed up.

steps.title: Finishes and final sign-off
steps.text: Board is hung, finished materials and mechanicals are installed, and any final inspections take place before the project wraps up.

service_area.h2: From Malden to the North Shore and southern New Hampshire
service_area.text: Halco is based at 650 Broadway in Malden and covers the Boston area north to southern New Hampshire. Its portfolio shows the range: kitchens in Malden, Melrose, Wakefield, Lynnfield, Woburn, Revere, Winthrop and Chelsea, North Shore work in Peabody, Beverly, Middleton, Topsfield, Boxford and Ipswich, and city projects in Cambridge, Brookline, Beacon Hill and the South End.

faq.h2: Before you book: common Halco questions

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
items.a: Halco lists 5 to 7 weeks for interior remodeling such as a kitchen or bath, project dependent. Additions typically take 12 to 16 weeks, and new construction runs 6 months to a year. A team member gives you an anticipated start date once the contract is signed and the deposit is placed.

Every associated project comes with a 5-year warranty. Cabinetry also carries a limited lifetime warranty. Because Halco supplies the cabinets as well as the labor, you have one company to call about both the installation and the boxes themselves, rather than chasing a separate cabinet supplier.

items.q: What cabinet options do you offer?
items.a: Halco works with quick ship, semi custom and full custom cabinetry, plus its own fully custom Halco Cabinet line. It can design in overlay, inset and frameless styles at all price points, and the same cabinetry shows up in built-ins, pantries, bars and mudrooms across its portfolio.

items.q: What should I expect once work starts?
items.a: You clear the work area of furniture, decor and cabinet contents. Halco protects floors and puts up plastic walls to contain dust, then completes demo, framing and rough mechanicals for the town inspector to sign off. After that come board, finishes and final inspections, all tracked in your online project portal.

Yes. Halco covers the Boston area north to southern New Hampshire. Recent projects include Melrose, Wakefield, Lynnfield, North Reading, Peabody, Beverly, Middleton, Topsfield, Boxford and Ipswich, along with Cambridge, Brookline and Boston condos and brownstones in the South End and Beacon Hill.

final_cta.text: Call (781) 324-6462 or book a discovery call online, and the Halco team will walk you through the process and next steps for your kitchen or bath.
